overview: A woman framed for her husband's murder suspects he is still alive; as she has already been tried for the crime, she can't be re-prosecuted if she finds and kills him.

recs.blurb: A woman turns to prescription medication as a way of handling her anxiety concerning her husband's upcoming release from prison.
A police chief about to retire pledges to help a woman find her daughter's killer. Based on a story by Swiss writer Friedrich Dürrenmatt.
Two brothers, on either side of the law, face off over organized crime in Brooklyn during the 1970s.
A serial murderer is strangling women with a necktie. The London police have a suspect, but he is the wrong man.
Sean Veil is an ultra paranoid murder suspect who takes to filming himself round the clock to provide an alibi, just in case he's ever accused of another…
Forced to work under slave-like conditions in a "prison for profit" program, the inmates of a mostly-African-American female prison, Whitehead Correctional…
In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is seduced by a woman seeking retribution.
A three-tiered story centered around drugs and organized crime, and focused on a young man who becomes a runner for a coke dealer.
A woman tries to straighten out her life, even as her past as a con-woman comes back to haunt her.
A dentist finds himself a murder suspect after a sexy patient seduces him into prescribing her drugs
An Argentinian crime drama revolving around a sheet of rare stamps (the Nine Queens).
